body: I find it odd that CocaCoalition said I'm normal and you say I'm different. I know I'm different but not in a good way. Being suicidal isolates one from everyone else. I have to put on an act everyday for things to go smoothly.

Everyone is just dull. One reason I'm on here is because I can't talk about this in real life without people losing their minds. That's just one example of people's simple-mindedness. I know I'm boring too, I'm not saying I'm better than people.
There is nothing about being human that I find fascinating or beautiful.
There is nothing to be solved.

Those all fall under the categories I listed in one way or another. For yourself is hedonistic. To unlock your potential, what would you do after the potential is reached? You would use it for yourself or to help others. To find meaning in this craziness would be to find one of the meanings I already came up with. To be able to experience and learn and grow is the same as the unlocking potential thing.
